cycle.title: Cycle
cycle.predictionDisclaimer: Cycle predictions are estimates and not a contraceptive method.

settings.title: Cycle settings
settings.subtitle: Edit your cycle configuration
settings.changeContext: Change life stage or birth control
settings.usualHint: Used until there's enough history to learn your own.
settings.showPredictionsHint: Turn off to keep logging without any predicted dates.
settings.showFertilityHint: Off by default. An informational estimate of the fertile window, not contraception.

fertility.explainMessage: The fertile window is estimated from your past cycle lengths. That can't reliably tell when you ovulate, so never use it alone to prevent pregnancy.

settings.privacyNote: Cycle records are encrypted on this phone. Backups you export are separate files that you control.
settings.summaryHint: A short PDF of what you logged: dates, bleeding, symptoms, pain and notes. It states your records and makes no diagnosis.
settings.pauseHint: Pausing keeps all your records and hides the cycle tab and reminders until you resume.

delete.title: Delete all cycle data?
delete.message: This permanently erases every period, daily log and life-stage entry from this phone. It can't be undone. Files you exported or shared earlier are outside the app and aren't affected. Shared mood entries remain available in Home and Progress.
delete.backupsMessage: This phone keeps {{count}} recovery point that can contain a copy of your cycle records, along with the rest of your data. Delete it as well?
delete.backupsMessage_plural: This phone keeps {{count}} recovery points that can contain a copy of your cycle records, along with the rest of your data. Delete them as well?

noData.title: Start tracking your cycle
noData.description: Keep period dates or track symptoms without bleeding. You can start without knowing your last period date.
noData.pausedDescription: Your history is saved. Resume to keep logging and see predictions.

periodLog.startDescription: Mark when your period began. You can log for today or a past date.
periodLog.pastDescription: Adding past period dates helps the app learn your cycle and make better predictions.

confidence.irregular: Cycles vary, so a date range is shown

lifeStage.pcos: With PCOS, cycles can be highly irregular. Predictions are rough estimates.
lifeStage.postPill: Coming off birth control: cycles may be irregular for 1–3 months.
lifeStage.postpartum: Postpartum cycles often return unpredictably, especially while breastfeeding.
lifeStage.perimenopause: Perimenopause can cause significant cycle irregularity. Showing an estimated range.

late.title: {{count}} day later than your usual range
late.title_plural: {{count}} days later than your usual range
late.description: Log your period when it starts and your predictions will update.

cycle.insufficient: Log a period to see a prediction

context.title: Life stage & birth control
context.description: Record a change from a date on. Your earlier history is kept.
context.chooseSpecific: Choose a specific type for better guidance.
context.effects: Some methods change how your cycle behaves, so predictions and the fertile window may be hidden or shown with a caveat.
context.lossQuietMessage: Predictions and period reminders have already stopped. You can also pause the daily check-in and other cycle reminders for 4 weeks. Pill reminders keep going. You can resume any time in cycle settings.

daySheet.title: Log this day
daySheet.moodUnavailable: Mood couldn't be loaded. Everything else still saves.
daySheet.severityOptional: How strong? Optional. Tap a rating again to clear it.
daySheet.painScale: 0 = no pain, 10 = the worst you can imagine
daySheet.clearMessage: This removes everything logged for this day, including its mood on Home and Progress. It can't be undone.

edit.title: Edit period
edit.deleteMessage: Your statistics and reminders are recalculated without it. You can undo right after.
edit.recalculates: Saving recalculates your statistics and reminders.

end.title: How did it end?
end.estimatedHint: Saved as an estimate, not as a recorded end date.
end.unknownHint: The length of this period won't be used in your averages.

errors.future: Period dates can't be in the future.
errors.overlap: This overlaps a period you already logged.
errors.endBeforeStart: The end can't be before the start.
errors.notFound: That period no longer exists. It may have been removed.

cycle.fertilityDisclaimer: Informational estimate only. Do not use it alone to prevent pregnancy.

reason.too_short: the gap was very short, possibly a mislog
reason.possible_missed_period: it was much longer than your others, possibly a missed period
reason.hormonal_context: a hormonal method was in use

insights.title: Patterns in your records
insights.recurringSymptom: You logged {{symptom}} within {{days}} days of your period starting in {{hits}} of your last {{total}} cycles.
insights.highPain: You logged pain of {{level}} or more within {{days}} days of your period starting in {{hits}} of your last {{total}} cycles.
insights.cycleLengthLonger: Your last cycle was {{length}} days, {{diff}} days longer than the median of your previous {{count}} cycles ({{typical}} days).
insights.cycleLengthShorter: Your last cycle was {{length}} days, {{diff}} days shorter than the median of your previous {{count}} cycles ({{typical}} days).
insights.durationLonger: Your last period lasted {{duration}} days, {{diff}} days longer than the median of your previous {{count}} ({{typical}} days).
insights.durationShorter: Your last period lasted {{duration}} days, {{diff}} days shorter than the median of your previous {{count}} ({{typical}} days).
insights.moodNearStart: Your logged mood was lower within {{days}} days of your period starting than on your other days in {{hits}} of your last {{total}} cycles.
insights.workoutNearStart: In {{hits}} of your last {{total}} cycles, your workouts within {{days}} days of your period starting had lower volume than your other sessions in the same cycle.
insights.recurringPreperiodSymptom: You logged {{symptom}} in the seven days before {{hits}} of {{total}} recorded periods.

prediction.insufficient: Log a period to see a prediction
prediction.caveated: This method can change how your cycle behaves, so treat the estimate loosely.
prediction.variabilityExpected: Cycle length varies in your situation. That's common, and the range reflects it.
prediction.variableHint: Your cycles have varied a lot ({{low}}–{{high}} days). A single date may not be reliable.
prediction.basis: Based on your last {{cycles}} cycle · median {{median}} days · range {{low}}–{{high}}
prediction.basis_plural: Based on your last {{cycles}} cycles · median {{median}} days · range {{low}}–{{high}}
prediction.basisNone: No usable cycles yet, so the estimate uses your usual length of {{days}} days.
prediction.recentWeighted: Recent cycles count more, so the estimate uses {{days}} days.
prediction.evidenceNote: Based on your data. A prediction is an estimate, not a medical result.

suppressed.hormonal: Bleeding on this method may not follow a natural cycle, so a predicted date wouldn't mean much. You can still log everything.
suppressed.postpartum: Cycles often return unpredictably after birth. Predictions will appear once you've logged two periods.
suppressed.no_bleeding: You're tracking without bleeding, so there is no period to predict. Daily logs and patterns still work.

quickLog.title: Quick log
quickLog.pinPrompt: You often log {{symptom}}. Pin it to the quick log?

summary.title: Cycle summary
summary.disclaimer: Self-recorded data from the Musclog app. It is not a diagnosis and does not replace medical advice.
summary.overviewNoLength: Not enough completed cycles to state a cycle length.
summary.overviewUsed: {{used}} cycles counted for averages, {{excluded}} not counted.
summary.pain: Pain logged on {{days}} days: median {{median}}/10, highest {{max}}/10, {{severe}} days at 6 or more.

personalize.title: Personalize tracking
personalize.goalsTitle: What would you like to understand?
personalize.goalsHint: Choose any that matter to you. You can change these later.
personalize.question: Would you like to track bleeding or cyclical symptoms?
personalize.trackBleedingHint: Keep period dates and daily observations.
personalize.trackSymptomsHint: Keep a body journal even when you do not bleed.
personalize.skipHint: You can enable tracking later in settings.
personalize.quickHint: Choose up to six symptoms for quick logging.
personalize.fieldsHint: Only your selected fields appear in the daily log.
personalize.removeHint: Removing a field from the form keeps its previously recorded values in history and exports.
personalize.observationsHint: Leave a field empty if you did not record it. Temperature is a manual observation and does not confirm ovulation.
personalize.invalidObservation: Check your entries: sleep must be 0–24 hours, temperature 30–45 °C, and number fields must contain a valid number.
personalize.sharedMoodHint: Mood is shared with Home and Progress. Clearing it here removes that day’s mood there too. Deleting cycle data keeps shared moods.
personalize.clearDayAndMood: Clear this day’s observations and shared mood

portability.title: Cycle backup and import
portability.recoveryHint: This file includes period history, daily observations, context, preferences and shared mood history. Save it outside this phone. Keep the password separately: without it, the backup cannot be recovered. Restore it below on your new device after enabling cycle tracking.
portability.noBackup: No encrypted cycle backup has been prepared on this device.
portability.plaintextHint: Readable JSON, CSV and PDF exports contain sensitive information without password protection. Only share them with someone you choose.
portability.importHint: Choose a Musclog cycle JSON backup or a periods, daily logs or context CSV exported by Musclog. Dates use YYYY-MM-DD. This merges cycle records and shared moods; your other app data stays intact.
portability.importPassword: Password for an encrypted file (otherwise leave empty)
portability.conflictHint: For a date that already has a record, choose whether to keep yours or replace the entire record with the imported entry.
portability.restorePreferences: Restore usual lengths, goals and field choices
portability.preview: {{added}} new records · {{updated}} replacements · {{skipped}} existing records kept · {{overlaps}} overlapping periods skipped
portability.overlapHint: Overlapping periods are skipped. Field definitions travel with the file so historic observations stay readable. The preview counts each period, day, context and mood separately.
portability.invalidFile: This file cannot be imported. Check its format, dates and field definitions.
portability.failed: Could not complete this action. Check the file or password and try again.
portability.prepared: Export prepared. Store the file somewhere you can recover it.
portability.fullBackupHint: Open Data settings for a full app backup and local recovery points. Export encryption is required by default. Restoring a full backup replaces app data; cycle-only import above merges it.

comparison.title: Compare your cycles
comparison.description: Compare your own logged observations by cycle day or before the next recorded period. Tap any day to view or edit it.
comparison.flowLegend: — not logged · 0 no bleeding · 1 spotting · 2 light · 3 medium · 4 heavy · 5 very heavy
comparison.symptomLegend: — not logged · 0 explicitly no symptoms · ● present, not rated · 1 mild · 2 moderate · 3 severe
comparison.numberLegend: — not logged. Numbers are your recorded ratings, not inferred values.
comparison.empty: Log period starts to compare cycles. The before-period view needs two starts.
comparison.limitHint: Shows your latest six cycles, up to 60 days after a start or 14 days before the next logged start. Empty days stay empty.

complete.unknownLength: I don't know my usual cycle length
complete.rangeHeuristic: This range is an estimate from your history, not a probability interval or a confirmed ovulation date.
complete.backtest: Retrospective check: {{hits}} of {{checked}} later starts fell within the range; average midpoint error {{error}} days. This is not clinical validation.
complete.careHint: General education from NHS and RCOG. Logging is not a diagnosis. If symptoms worry you or affect daily life, discuss them with a healthcare professional; seek urgent local care for severe or rapidly worsening symptoms.
complete.trendsHint: Explore your recorded days, including when you don't have periods. These are observations, not explanations of what caused a change.
complete.summary: {{logged}} logged days · {{heavy}} heavy-flow days · {{spotting}} spotting days · {{impact}} days with daily-life impact
complete.recap: Since the recorded start on {{date}}: {{logged}} logged days, {{heavy}} heavy-flow days, {{impact}} days with daily-life impact.
complete.loggedOnly: Only recorded values are shown. Missing days are unknown. The latest 30 values are listed.
complete.noObservations: No matching observations in this range.
complete.contextChanged: Context changed on {{date}}. See context history.
complete.searchHint: Search symptoms, notes, medication, tags or custom values. All words must match. Search stays on this device; up to 50 matching days are shown.
complete.importHint: {{rows}} CSV rows. Columns: {{columns}}. Enter the exact column names below; leave optional fields empty. This wizard accepts CSV, not proprietary archives.
complete.importPeriods: Each row records a period start (not a daily log)
complete.importError: Check the column names, date order, and values. Flow accepts none, spotting, light, medium, heavy or very_heavy; temperature must be in °C. Duplicate period starts and invalid dates cannot be imported.
complete.healthTitle: Cycle data in your health store
complete.healthHint: Read bleeding and basal temperature with your permission. Imported observations keep their source and never replace your manual logs or create period starts. Health-store access can be limited by platform history permissions.
complete.healthPreview: {{count}} observations available. Re-importing the same source IDs updates their imported copies only.
complete.healthWriteHint: This writes your manual bleeding and basal-temperature entries in the selected range to your device's health store. Other apps with permission may read them. Imported observations, symptoms, mood, medication, sex and notes are excluded. Very heavy flow is exported as heavy.
complete.healthError: Health access failed or permission was declined. Check device health permissions and try again. A failed export may have written some records; retrying updates Musclog's own records.
complete.sharingHint: Choose exactly what to share. This creates a readable JSON file for your selected range. The recipient can keep or forward the file; this is not live access and cannot be revoked. Nothing is selected by default.
complete.presetsHint: Add useful fields and fill unused favorite slots. Your history and existing favorites stay intact.
complete.pmsDiaryHint: A daily symptom-and-impact diary over two consecutive cycles can support a clinical conversation about PMS. This diary is not a validated PMDD questionnaire and does not diagnose PMDD.
complete.fertilityHint: Temperature, discharge and test results are observations only. They do not confirm ovulation or make calendar estimates suitable for contraception.
complete.stagePregnancyHint: Period and fertility predictions are paused. Keep your symptom records and change context when ready.
complete.stageLossHint: A quiet tracking context with no period or fertility predictions. Your history is kept; return to another context when ready.
complete.stageSurgeryHint: Track symptoms without period or fertility predictions. Surgery does not automatically tell us whether you still have ovarian cycles.
complete.stageMenopauseHint: Track symptoms without period or fertility predictions. Unexpected bleeding can still be recorded.
complete.chartDescription: {{metric}} over time. Each dot is a recorded value; dates and values are listed below.
complete.variabilitySummary: {{count}} recorded cycle intervals in this range: {{low}}–{{high}} days, including intervals excluded from predictions.
complete.energyInsight: You logged lower energy near period starts in {{hits}} of {{total}} observed cycles. This does not establish a cause.
complete.sleepInsight: You logged shorter sleep near period starts in {{hits}} of {{total}} observed cycles. This does not establish a cause.
complete.reviewLong: Treat this long cycle as uncertain again

periodStart.title: Period may start soon
periodStart.body: Based on your recent cycles, your period may start around {{from}}. This is an estimate.
periodStart.bodyRange: Based on your recent cycles, your period may start between {{from}} and {{to}}. This is an estimate.

periodDue.title: Period may start today
periodDue.body: Today is the most likely start, based on your recent cycles. Log it when it happens.

periodLate.title: This cycle is longer than usual
periodLate.body: This cycle is longer than your recent pattern. There are many possible reasons. Tap if you'd like to update it.
periodLate.bodyRange: This cycle is longer than your recent pattern, which usually ends by {{to}}. There are many possible reasons. Tap if you'd like to update it.

fertileWindow.title: Estimated fertile window
fertileWindow.body: Your estimated fertile window may begin {{from}}. It's a calendar estimate, not confirmation of ovulation, and not contraception.
fertileWindow.bodyRange: Your estimated fertile window is {{from}} to {{to}}. It's a calendar estimate, not confirmation of ovulation, and not contraception.

dailyLog.title: Daily cycle check-in
dailyLog.body: Record today if you want to.

endCheck.title: Is your period still going?
endCheck.body: The period you marked as ongoing started a week ago. Update its end when you're ready.

backup.title: Cycle backup
backup.body: Consider saving an encrypted backup of your records.

reminders.leadDays: Days of notice before your period

basis.estimate: an estimate from your logged cycles

reminders.notWhileSuppressed: not sent while predictions are off for your situation

periodStart.label: Before my period
periodStart.when: At {{time}}, with the notice set below, before the earliest predicted start

periodDue.label: On the most likely day
periodDue.when: At {{time}} on the most likely start day

periodLate.label: If this cycle runs long
periodLate.when: The day after your usual range ends, in neutral wording

fertileWindow.label: Estimated fertile window
fertileWindow.when: At {{time}} when the estimated window begins
fertileWindow.unavailable: Available only with the fertile-window estimate turned on, in a situation where it means something.

endCheck.label: Check an ongoing period
endCheck.when: A week after a period you marked as ongoing

pill.label: Pill reminder
pill.packStart: First pill of the current pack
pill.hint: Pill-free days get no reminder. This is a reminder, not medical advice: follow your pill's instructions if you miss one.

pause.title: Pause cycle reminders
pause.hint: For illness, grief, travel or a break. Pill reminders keep going.

status.web: Reminders are delivered by the Musclog phone app. Settings made here apply there too.
status.noPermission: Notifications are not allowed for Musclog, so no reminder can arrive.
status.switchedOff: Cycle notifications are switched off, so no reminder will arrive.
status.paused: Reminders are paused until you resume them.
status.none: Nothing is scheduled. Turn on a reminder below.
status.permissionDenied: Notifications were not allowed. You can allow them in your phone's settings.

reminders.testSent: Sent. It arrives in a few seconds, worded as you chose.

style.title: Lock-screen wording
style.hint: What someone glancing at your phone could read. Private never says what a reminder is about.

reminders.lockScreenHint: On a locked phone with a secure lock screen, Android also hides the text of cycle reminders.

why.title: Why you got this reminder
why.setting: You turned on “{{reminder}}” in cycle settings.
why.estimateFromCycles: Its date is an estimate from your logged cycles ({{cycles}} used), which have been {{low}} to {{high}} days long. A reminder can't be more precise than that.
why.estimateFromSetup: Its date comes from the usual cycle length you entered, because there isn't enough logged history yet. It gets better as you log periods.
why.routine: It goes off at the time you chose, whatever your cycle data says.
why.pillBreak: It skips the pill-free days of your pack.
why.late: A longer cycle has many possible reasons. Musclog never assumes one.
why.estimateFromSteadyCycles: Its date is an estimate from your logged cycles ({{cycles}} used), which have all been about {{low}} days long. Cycles can still vary, so treat it as approximate.
